card.title: Lost and Found - Jingle Bell Rescue

chapters.title: House 5 - Pink House with a Red Door and Christmas Tree

tracks.title: House 5 - Pink House with a Red Door and Christmas Tree

metadata.description: Help Santa’s reindeer find their missing jingle bells in this interactive holiday audio adventure! Kids will explore 35 charming North Pole houses, each filled with festive surprises and detailed descriptions, as they search for Dasher, Vixen, Prancer, and Blitzen’s lost bells. With imaginative storytelling and a touch of holiday magic, this game encourages creative play and is perfect for adding extra cheer to the Christmas season!
